---
name: Missing format or operation
about: An image format broimage cannot read or write, or an image operation it does not have
labels: enhancement
---

**What is missing:** the format (with a sample file if you can share one) or
the operation, and its expected signature.

**What needs it:** the library or app that would use it. broimage is the one
home for image work in the bro ecosystem, so say if you are working around
it elsewhere today.
